dependencies.description: Stores equipment, loans and their status.

description: Backend API for the equipment catalog and loan lifecycle: adding, editing and retiring equipment; borrowing, returning, listing and extending loans. Enforces office-manager-only inventory management and the office manager's cross-staff overdue view. Does not send notifications and does not serve any UI.
